<thought>To obtain the template ID, I will search the template catalog for a template that breaks a ketone (functional group “ketones”) and forms a C‑C single bond (bond type “6-6”). This should return the template whose SMARTS is “[C:1](=O)[C:2]>>[C:1][C:2]”, allowing me to retrieve its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(c2ccccc2)Oc3c(ccc(O)c3)O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
